title: Why this matters for money
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: DataWeave uses arbitrary-precision arithmetic, so 0.1 + 0.2 + 0.3 is exactly 0.6. But if you use the result in a price list, you need it rounded to cents, which is round(...) for dollars.
